nodes.question: What are some of the factors contributing to the high probability of disaster occurrences in Ecuador?
nodes.answer: Inadequate land use, population density, lack of territorial planning, and natural hazards are contributing factors.
nodes.paragraph: 2012). In general, Ecuador is characterized by its great bio- and geodiversity, highlighting its geographic setting with a varied topography, high precipitation, temperature variations, as well as it soil fertility and provision of natural resources, allowing this country to be a suitable place for the development of various activities, which however, may be inter - ferred of the highly occurrences of chracterizing adverse natural events within its terri- tory. The probability of occurrence of catastrophes based on disasters is very high, due to inadequate land use, population density, lack of territorial planning, natural hazards, along with adverse phenomena being the main triggers for large-scale disasters (Bustamante 2018). The main historical cases of mass movements in the country are concentrated in the Andean and sub-Andean regions, with predominating rotational movements. Based on the aforementioned, on February 12, 2021 in the La Armenia sector, located in the Andean region of Ecuador, a landslide occurred, which affected a total area of some 115.35 hectares. This event comprised an approximate volume of 30 million cubic meters of eroded material, generating damming of the Picay River, which itself caused a debris flow.
